summary:
user: I am busy right now, call me later.
assistant: I understand you are busy right now. I will arrange for a callback later. Is there a preferred day or time you would like us to call you back?
user: I don't know, sometime later.
assistant: I understand. I will note that you would like us to call back later. When would be a good time for us to reach you?
user: Okay, bye.
assistant: I've saved your details and your request for a follow-up call. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
